capabilities: Sync Google Tasks two-way, including lists, notes, due dates, completion and subtasks
Manage tasks on a Kanban board grouped by list, due date or status
Show tasks on a month or week calendar with drag-to-reschedule
Draw random tasks in gift mode and complete them one at a time
Insert today's tasks into the daily note as a checklist
disambiguation: Not a reward or gamification app; gift mode is one optional view over a full two-way Google Tasks sync.
extras: Requires a one-time self-hosted Google Cloud OAuth client (about 5 minutes); Google shows an 'unverified app' warning unless the app is published. The data note stores the client secret and access tokens and must be excluded from publishing or public repos. Refresh tokens expire every 7 days while the OAuth app is in Testing mode.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync tasks with Google Tasks or to view and edit those tasks inside the vault.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that syncs your Google Tasks both ways
sync tools such as Self-hosted LiveSync deliver new settings to your other devices right away

summary: Two-way Google Tasks sync with a Kanban board, calendar view, and a gift mode that reveals one or more random tasks at a time.
